title: State-dependent decoupling of sensory and motor circuits underlies behavioral flexibility in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'Two identified DN types contribute to landing responses'; Fig. 1e; Supplementary Fig. 3; Supplementary videos 4-5
quote: Only two DN types, DNp07 and DNp10 (Fig. 1d), drove landing-like extensions of all six legs when activated
mapping_basis: The paper uses the Namiki type name DNp07, which is a MANC type in type_list.csv; line SS01549 maps to DNp07 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 625 nm fibre-coupled LED from below; 300-ms pulses (Fig. 1 experiments)
coordination_notes: simultaneous extension of all six legs, front legs reaching beyond the head (landing posture)
n_flies_note: front leg extension angle n = 12 front legs from N = 6 flies; latency N = 7 flies, n = 21 trials
notes: DNp07-split-GAL4-2 (SS01549) was used for Fig. 1e and Supp. Fig. 3. Supp. Fig. 1b says this line has weaker expression in a second DN, DNp13. One of 133 DN split lines activated during flight, but the paper does not report the other lines individually.

title: State-dependent decoupling of sensory and motor circuits underlies behavioral flexibility in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results, 'Two identified DN types contribute to landing responses'; Fig. 1e; Supplementary Fig. 1b; Supplementary Fig. 3
quote: Only two DN types, DNp07 and DNp10 (Fig. 1d), drove landing-like extensions of all six legs when activated
mapping_basis: Supplementary Fig. 1b names the off-target DN in SS01549 as DNp13, an exact MANC type name; driver_lines.csv lists SS01549 with DNp13.
stimulation: 625 nm fibre-coupled LED from below; 300-ms pulses (Fig. 1 experiments)
coordination_notes: simultaneous extension of all six legs (landing posture)
n_flies_note: front leg extension N = 6 flies; latency N = 7 flies
notes: Record exists because SS01549 labels DNp13 weakly in addition to DNp07 (Supp. Fig. 1b: 'weaker expression in a second DN (DNp13)'). The authors attribute the landing extension to DNp07. They note that DNp13 does not innervate leg neuropils (Supp. Fig. 1e), and the DNp07-only line SS02276 gives the same phenotype. This is weak evidence for DNp13 itself.
